transmission_screen.scope: Quasi-static linkage equilibrium over modeled knee range. Equal reactions assumed for the two fork ears. External impact can exceed this load. Pin bearing pressure is not a tensile stress or a failure prediction.

material_reference.name: Bambu PETG HF TDS V1.0
material_reference.coupon_conditions: 100% infill, 255 C nozzle, 70 C bed, 200 mm/s; specimens annealed and dried at 75 C for 8 h. Manufacturer discourages annealing complex PETG HF parts because of deformation.
material_reference.use: Illustrates anisotropy. Not a material allowable for these parts, another PETG formulation or an unannealed print.

qualification_required: Same-filament coupons printed with the actual profile, dry material and expected motor-adjacent temperature
Full leg static tests in forward/back bending, lateral bending, torsion and pushrod load; measure residual deformation and bearing alignment
Sustained-load creep and clamp-retention tests at service temperature
Repeated gait loads, controlled impacts and post-test inspection of hole edges, root fillets and layers
scope: Orientation and analytical load screen. No orthotropic FEA, slicer toolpath inspection, destructive tests or lifetime qualification.
